task.title: naturalsize writes the locale decimal separator
task.body:
Why: https://github.com/python-humanize/humanize/issues/460 ; src/humanize/filesize.py formats with the format string only and never calls decimal_separator(), unlike intword and intcomma. After `humanize.i18n.activate("fr_FR")`, `naturalsize(1_500_000)` returns '1.5 Mo' while `intcomma(1.5)` returns '1,5'.
Outcome: `humanize.naturalsize(value, binary=False, gnu=False, format="%.1f")` writes the locale decimal separator in the number part for the active locale: with fr_FR active `naturalsize(1_500_000) == '1,5 Mo'` and `naturalsize(1_500_000, format="%.2f") == '1,50 Mo'` and `naturalsize(1_500_000, gnu=True) == '1,4M'`; with de_DE active `naturalsize(1_500_000) == '1,5 MB'`. A value without a fraction digit keeps no separator: fr_FR `naturalsize(3_000_000, format="%.0f") == '3 Mo'`. With no locale active (or after `humanize.i18n.deactivate()`) nothing changes: `naturalsize(1_500_000) == '1.5 MB'`, `naturalsize(1_500_000, gnu=True) == '1.4M'`.
Proof: add tests to tests/test_filesize.py that activate and deactivate the locales.

spec: `humanize.naturalsize(value, binary=False, gnu=False, format="%.1f")` writes the locale decimal separator in the number part for the active locale: with fr_FR active `naturalsize(1_500_000) == '1,5 Mo'` and `naturalsize(1_500_000, format="%.2f") == '1,50 Mo'` and `naturalsize(1_500_000, gnu=True) == '1,4M'`; with de_DE active `naturalsize(1_500_000) == '1,5 MB'`. A value without a fraction digit keeps no separator: fr_FR `naturalsize(3_000_000, format="%.0f") == '3 Mo'`. With no locale active (or after `humanize.i18n.deactivate()`) nothing changes: `naturalsize(1_500_000) == '1.5 MB'`, `naturalsize(1_500_000, gnu=True) == '1.4M'`.
install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q babel -e '.[tests]' && .venv/bin/pybabel --quiet compile --directory src/humanize/locale --domain humanize
